svg.text: Grover - spine deck wiring (top view, front up)
rover32 on the Freenove FNK0101, half breadboard beside it; wires off the deck go to the front sensors (left), the LED chain (top) and the power deck below (bottom)
USB (rear) - never with the pack connected
5V and GND from the 5V / GND rails
Left DRV8871 (left track): IN1 <- GPIO22 IN2 <- GPIO23 GND <- ESP GND
Right DRV8871 (right track): IN1 <- GPIO19 IN2 <- GPIO18 GND <- ESP GND
DANGER: header VM = 12 V (tied to the POWER terminals). Leave it UNCONNECTED.
Buck OUT (5.29 V) + GND -> breadboard 5V / GND rails
12 V bus (+ Wago) -> 100k -> sense node -> 27k -> GND; node -> GPIO34
Forward = IN1 high, IN2 PWM (both sides). A track running backward is fixed by
swapping its IN1/IN2 pins in firmware, not the wires.
Wires reach it down the centre slot (signals) and past the breadboard's rear end (power).
Cliff VCC on 3V3: the HW-870's output pulls up
to its VCC, so on 5 V it would drive the ESP32
Gyro: one pin per breadboard row; wire
yaw axis moves off Z (stands upright).
Pin side: GPIO 34/35 are input-only (fine here).
